title: Edited-photo render never lands after an account switch: tray card stays 'rendering' and a held Send waits forever
trigger: In account A attach a photo, open the editor, press Done (render starts, tray card gets photo_render=Some(n)); before the PNG lands switch to account B. The task's screen epoch is stale, so update_in fails and the fallback app.main().update (which keeps the same stale screen epoch) also fails; the PNG is deleted. Press Send in A first so a Send is held, or switch back to A later.
effect: Back in A the card is stuck rendering (photo_render never cleared anywhere else), tray_renders_an_edit() is true so every Send is parked as held_send with 'Preparing the files' and never goes, and Edit on the card defers forever (photo_editor_after). Only removing the card frees it.
fix: Make the card's state an enum (Ready / Rendering{token}) owned by the tray, and settle it from the dropped continuation: on Gone fall back to ScopedApp::app() (no screen) to land_attachment_edit(None) instead of main(), which keeps the stale epoch.

title: Removing or reordering a saved track reports success before (and whatever) the driver result; errors are discarded
trigger: On your own Playlist page choose Delete on a track and confirm while the request cannot be sent (connection lost, client not ready); or drag a track to reorder.
effect: 'Saved music removed' toast shows immediately, remove_profile_audio_track/move_profile_audio_track Err is dropped with `let _`, and the track stays; no error is ever shown.
fix: Set the toast from the Result (Ok -> removed, Err -> error note) as the other pin/poll starters do, and carry a request id so a later failure from TDLib can surface.

title: Keep original aspect ratio uses the unrotated ratio after Rotate
trigger: Set-sticker editor with a wide image: press Rotate once (crop, base item and orientation turn), then toggle Keep original aspect ratio off and on again.
effect: toggle_keep_ratio rebuilds the crop from original_ratio as if the image were unturned, so the crop is the wrong shape (cuts picture or leaves padding) for a quarter-turned base.
fix: Model the crop as an enum CropMode::{Full, KeepRatio} and derive the rect from the current orientation at use, instead of storing keep_ratio beside a crop that rotate/flip rewrite by hand.

title: File picked for a poll option lands on a row index that may have changed
trigger: Click the paperclip on row 3 -> Photo or video; while the native file panel is open (non-modal on some platforms) remove row 1 from the poll box; pick a file.
effect: take_poll_option_file(AttachTarget::Row(3)) attaches the media to whatever option is now at index 3 (or nothing), not the row that asked.
fix: Give each option row a stable id (OptionId) and target AttachTarget::Row(OptionId) so an answer is matched to the row that asked.

title: Seek drag held as seek_scrubbing bool plus seek_preview_secs Option plus seek_hover
trigger: Slider Change sets scrubbing=true and preview=Some; Release clears both; stop/start clear both. The tick (finished && !seek_scrubbing) and the bar (preview.is_some()) read different copies of the same stage.
effect: If a Release is ever lost the tick never ends a finished track while the bar still shows a drag.
fix: enum Seek { Idle, Hover(SeekHover), Scrubbing{preview_secs} }.

title: Progress tick task guarded by a bool (tick) next to tick_shown
trigger: spawn_playback_tick sets tick=true and the task clears it when it ends; a new track on a paused tick pokes CHROME instead.
effect: Works today because OnScreen is replaced whole and the old task ends on Gone, but the 'task running' stage is a hand-kept bool.
fix: enum Tick { Stopped, Running(Task) } owning the task so dropping the value ends it.

title: builds_watched bool as a 'task started' flag
trigger: watch_audio_builds uses mem::replace(&mut builds_watched, true) and never clears it; the spawn_app task ends only when the app is gone.
effect: No bug today; if the task ever ended early the engine builds would never land again.
fix: Hold the watcher as Option<Task> / enum BuildWatch { Off, On(Task) }.

title: Poll option attach UI mode is four fields resolved by a priority chain
trigger: OptionAttach holds link_input Option, emoji_wait, sticker_wait, menu_open next to media; poll_option_attach_area picks link > emoji > sticker > menu, and the choose_*/start_* starters clear the others by hand (choose_poll_option_sticker leaves emoji_wait, choose_poll_option_emoji leaves other rows' sticker_wait).
effect: Two modes can be set at once (hidden one still routes picks from the media panel); closing the panel without Done/Cancel leaves the wait on.
fix: enum AttachMode { Closed, Menu, Link(Entity<TextareaState>), PickingSticker, PickingEmoji } owned per option, plus media: OptionMediaSlot.

title: Poll box steps (poll / country picker / deadline picker / discard prompt) are separate Options and a bool
trigger: PollDialog has country_box Option, deadline_box Option and confirming_discard bool; panel and footer test them in order and Esc handling tests them in order.
effect: Both pickers or a picker plus the discard prompt can be set together; the later one is hidden but alive.
fix: enum PollStep { Editing, Country(CountryBox), Deadline(DeadlineBox), ConfirmDiscard }.

title: Preview player and its file id are two cells kept in step by hand
trigger: preview_player sets video then file_id; stop() clears both; a failed player stays in the slot with its file id.
effect: No bug today; a writer that sets one without the other leaves a player for the wrong clip.
fix: RefCell<Option<(FileId, VideoPlayer)>>.

title: Playlist track menu page is a save_to bool inside PlaylistMenu; removal confirm is a separate Option
trigger: Right-click a track, Save to... flips save_to; Delete sets playback.playlist_remove and opens a box while playlist_menu is closed by hand.
effect: No bug today.
fix: enum PlaylistMenuPage { Main, SaveTo } and one enum PlaylistUi { None, Menu{..}, ConfirmRemove(FileId) }.

title: Poll voters/stats dialog: show_stats bool + selected_option Option, fetch state in the session map
trigger: open_poll_voters_dialog / open_poll_stats_dialog set the same struct with show_stats true/false; selected_option None/Some drives which fetch is read.
effect: No bug today.
fix: enum PollDialogView { Voters{option}, Stats{option: Option<usize>} }.

title: A privacy rule whose save failed on the server is left Failed and every further edit in the open editor is silently ignored
trigger: Settings > Privacy > open a rule editor (e.g. Last seen); change a choice or add an exception while the server rejects the set (PRIVACY_TOO_LONG, flood, offline); then click another choice or Add user in the same editor.
effect: The row turns to 'Couldn't load', no radio is selected, no toast is shown (reducer comment says never toasts), and mutate_privacy_detail returns early for non-Ready so clicks do nothing and say nothing until the Privacy page is reopened (fetch_privacy).
fix: On a failed set, refetch the rule (like SetSenderBlockList does) or keep the last Ready detail in a PrivacyKeyState::Ready{detail, save: Fetch<()>} variant and show the error in the editor.

title: Premium sticker examples are downloaded only during a fixed 6 second timer poll; a slower answer is never downloaded
trigger: Open a Premium sticker preview (click a Premium sticker without Premium) on a slow connection so getPremiumStickers answers later than 10 x 600 ms.
effect: The loop ends before preview_stickers() has any file id, so no download is requested and the stage keeps the emoji fallback tiles until the page is left and re-entered.
fix: Download the stickers from the reducer when the premium_stickers answer lands (answer-driven), not by a wall-clock poll bounded by a loop count.

title: Preview clip is fetched only if the Premium state arrives within 24 x 250 ms
trigger: Open a Premium feature preview before premium_state is known, on a connection where getPremiumState takes longer than 6 s.
effect: fetch_preview_clip gives up, the animation file is never downloaded and the stage shows the star placeholder for as long as the preview page is open.
fix: Trigger the clip download when premium_state is applied (reducer effect keyed by the shown feature) instead of polling for a fixed time.

title: Revoke of a public link: if the second request fails to send, the first (username cleared) is already out and no revoke is recorded
trigger: Limit box > Revoke on a public community while the sender fails on the second send_json_request (disconnect between the two sends).
effect: setSupergroupUsername('') goes through but groups.group_type.revoke stays None and public_chats is not reset, so the list still shows the chat with a link it no longer has; the 'disable' pending entry leaks.
fix: Record PublicLinkRevoke before sending (or send both through one fallible step that rolls back) and reset public_chats on a partial send failure.

title: The revoke follow-up poll stops after 10 s without rechecking the Type box link
trigger: Revoke a public link while TDLib answers slower than 50 x 200 ms (flood wait).
effect: The spawn_screen loop exits without calling recheck_group_type_link, so the Type box keeps the 'link taken' status after the revoke finished.
fix: Run recheck_group_type_link from the reducer when the revoke settles, not from a bounded timer poll.

title: A clip that fails to open is retried on every render
trigger: Open a Premium feature preview whose downloaded clip cannot be opened by VideoPlayer::open.
effect: Only a player that opens and later reports Failed is kept in the slot; an Err from open is not remembered, so each re-render (hover, scroll, tick) re-opens the file.
fix: Make the slot an enum Idle / Playing(VideoPlayer) / Failed(file_id).

title: 'Buy more Stars' stays expanded after the Stars box is closed and reopened
trigger: Stars > Buy more Stars (expands list) > close Stars > open Stars again.
effect: The pack list is open at once because StarPacksState::open lives in the session and close_stars (mod.rs:129) does not reset it.
fix: Own the expanded flag in the Stars box UI state or reset it in close_stars.

title: Block and exception pickers say 'No more contacts' while the contacts are still being fetched
trigger: Privacy > Block... (or Add user in an exception list) before contacts are loaded.
effect: contact_rows() is empty until fetch_contacts answers, so the picker shows the empty-state text instead of a loading state.
fix: Show Fetch::Loading for the contacts list in the picker.

title: Stars history stage is tx_loading + tx_loaded + tx_error + tx_offset on PremiumHub
trigger: n/a (no bug found today)
effect: n/a
fix: Fetch<Page<StarTx>> with a next-offset variant.

title: Received gifts stage is gifts_loading + gifts_loaded + gifts_error + gifts_offset
trigger: n/a (no bug found today)
effect: n/a
fix: Fetch<Page<ReceivedGift>>.

title: Gift detail mode is gift_selected + gift_convert_confirm + gift_mutating kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a (no bug found today)
effect: n/a
fix: enum GiftView { List, Detail(id), ConfirmConvert(id), Mutating(id) }.

title: Grams history stage is loading + loaded + error + request + probed + peers_dirty on GramsHub
trigger: n/a (no bug found today)
effect: n/a
fix: Fetch<Page<TonTx>> carrying the request id; probed as Fetch<balance>.

title: One-shot withdraw_url / withdraw_too_small flags next to GramWithdraw, consumed by per-frame upkeep
trigger: n/a (no bug found today)
effect: n/a
fix: Make the outcome a GramWithdraw::Done(Url|TooSmall) variant or a queued effect the window drains.

title: Star packs stage is open + loading + loaded + error + options
trigger: n/a (no bug found today)
effect: n/a
fix: Fetch<Vec<Pack>> plus the expanded flag in UI state.

title: Premium dialog is premium_open + promo_page + premium_ref + premium_requested + premium_loading/premium_error
trigger: n/a (no bug found today)
effect: n/a
fix: Option<PremiumBox{page, ref, requested}> and Fetch<PremiumInfo>.

title: limit_box Option and limit_toast Option are two one-shot slots for one limit event
trigger: n/a (no bug found today)
effect: n/a
fix: One enum LimitNotice { Box{kind,extra}, Toast(kind) } drained by the window.

title: Privacy page layers are a hand-kept stack of editor, exceptions, exception_picker_open, block_picker_open, unblock_confirm, last_seen_warning
trigger: n/a (no bug found today)
effect: n/a
fix: enum PrivacyLayer { Page, Editor(t), Exceptions(t,k,Picker), BlockPicker, ConfirmUnblock(id), LastSeenWarning(detail) }.

title: Read-date setting is read_date_show + read_date_loading + read_date_error
trigger: n/a (no bug found today)
effect: n/a
fix: Fetch<bool> with an optimistic variant.

title: PrivacyUi keeps file_open + file_open_remember, session_details + renaming_device, network_reset_confirm as separate fields
trigger: n/a (no bug found today)
effect: n/a
fix: FileOpenConfirm{path,warning,remember}; enum SessionView { List, Details(id), Renaming(id) }.

title: Edit profile Save closes the box as saved before the server answers; a rejected name or bio error is shown nowhere
trigger: Open Edit profile, type a bio TDLib rejects or a name it refuses, press Save. save_profile_form only checks that the request was queued, sets the 'Name update requested' note and calls close_edit_profile_dialog.
effect: The dialog disappears and the user believes the edit was saved. The failure lands in users_state.profile_edit_error (state/domains/users/error.rs), which only the edit-profile and peer-colour dialogs draw, so it is never seen and the old values come back.
fix: Keep the dialog in a Saving(requests) stage that leaves on the answer (close) or the error (stay open with the error), instead of closing on enqueue.

title: Username check is three loose session fields (username_check, username_check_pending, profile_edit_error) reset by hand at every entry point
trigger: open_edit_profile_dialog, check_profile_username, submit_profile_username, move/toggle username and remove photo each clear profile_edit_error (and open clears username_check and username_check_pending) by hand; the dialog derives 'checking' from pending text equal to the typed text.
effect: No bug today; a new entry point that forgets one reset shows a stale verdict or error. profile_edit_error is also shared with the peer colour dialog.
fix: One Fetch<(String, UsernameCheckResult)> keyed by the checked text, and one per-dialog error owned by the dialog that asked.

title: Rating box is an Option<i64> plus a rating_preview bool kept in step by hand
trigger: Click the rating pill (sets rating_box, then clears rating_preview), press Preview (toggles the bool), close (close_rating_box clears both).
effect: No bug today; any new closer that clears only rating_box leaves rating_preview true so the next person's box opens in Future Rating.
fix: Option<RatingBox { user_id, view: Current | Future }>.

title: Rating box stays open with an empty body when the person's full info or rating goes away
trigger: Open the rating box, then the account's user_full_info for that person is dropped or has no rating (account switch back, info refresh without ratings).
effect: rating_box_target() returns None ('None closes it') but build_rating_box only draws an empty div with the Understood button; the is_open check (rating_box.is_some()) stays true, so an empty box remains until dismissed.
fix: Close the box (clear rating_box) when its target no longer resolves, or make is_open use rating_box_target().is_some().

title: Business hours expanded and time-zone choice are one global flag pair, not per profile
trigger: Open a business profile, expand its hours and switch to the business time zone, then open another business profile (or the same panel for another user).
effect: The second profile's hours row opens already expanded and in the first person's chosen zone; nothing resets the pair when the profile changes (only written in profile_business.rs, never reset).
fix: Key the state by user id (Option<(UserId, HoursView)>) or hold it in the profile panel owner that is replaced when the target changes.

title: ProfileModal fade stage is a closing bool beside the Glide, and the modal also mirrors session.open_info_panel
trigger: Click an avatar (opening), close it (closing = true plus a timer), open another avatar during the fade (the modal is taken and rebuilt keeping previous).
effect: No bug found: the timer matches on closing and target. The stage is closing + glide direction + whether the session's info panel still equals target (profile_modal_active) kept in step by hand.
fix: enum ModalStage { Opening, Open, Closing } with the glide inside the variants.

title: Personal photo picker overwrites whichever profile dialog is open when the answer arrives and leaves a box host set when cancelled
trigger: Edit contact > Set Photo (file picker opens, open_box(ProfilePanel) runs before profile_dialog is set); cancel the picker, or open Birthday meanwhile and then pick a file.
effect: On cancel hosts[ProfilePanel] stays Host::Asked with no dialog open; on a late pick the answer replaces profile_dialog unconditionally, dropping the dialog the user is typing in.
fix: Model the pick as ProfileDialog::PickingPhoto{user_id, mode} set before the prompt (and cancelled by the answer), and apply the answer only when that exact stage is still current.

title: Retry on a failed profile chat list removes the Failed entry and ignores a synchronous send error
trigger: Open a profile whose groups-in-common or similar-channels fetch Failed, go offline so chats_path_active is false (or the sender is closed), press Retry.
effect: retry_profile_chats removes the (kind,key) entry first and drops the Err from fetch_*; the Retry row vanishes and nothing is loading, so the list never offers Retry again until the panel is reopened.
fix: Only remove the Failed entry after the fetch returned Ok(Some), or set it back to Failed on Err.

title: A channel photo gallery click that fails to send waits forever with no message
trigger: Click a group or channel avatar while the chats path is not active (fetch_chat_photos returns Err, ignored by let _).
effect: open_peer_photos treats PhotoOwner::Chat as sent, calls wait_for_profile_gallery, nothing is requested and no Failed entry exists, so the click does nothing and pending_profile_gallery stays set until another click replaces it (and may open late if photos arrive for it).
fix: Use the fetch_chat_photos result like the User branch: on Err show the note and do not set the pending gallery; clear the pending gallery on request end.

title: PendingGallery is an Option holding five snapshot keys compared by hand (window, chat, panel, viewer opens, lock count)
trigger: Click a profile photo, move on (other chat, close panel, lock) before the photos load.
effect: No bug today: pending_gallery_still_wanted compares them. The pending slot itself has no way out except the answer or a Failed entry, so a request that never answers keeps it set.
fix: Fetch<PhotoGallery> stage owned by the viewer open request, dropped when its owner key changes.

title: Edit contact, birthday, personal channel, photo and share-contact boxes close and toast success on enqueue, not on the answer
trigger: Save an edited contact or birthday, pick a personal channel, confirm a personal photo, or send a shared contact while Telegram rejects the request (flood, privacy, invalid value).
effect: The box closes and shows 'Contact saved' / 'Birthday saved' at once; a server error has no place to show, so the user sees success and the old value reappears.
fix: ProfileDialog variants carry a Saving stage that closes on the answer and shows the error in the box on failure.

title: ProfileDialog sub-steps (ShareContact target, EditContact note Seeded, Birthday error) are mutated in place from render closures
trigger: Share contact: pick a chat, Back; Edit contact before full info lands; Birthday with a bad date.
effect: No bug found; steps are variants or Options inside ProfileDialog, but the box host (hosts[ProfilePanel]) and the dialog value are set in two separate calls everywhere, and the file picker path sets the host before the value.
fix: One open_profile_dialog(value) that sets both together.

title: Disable Sharing explainer counts as shown when it opens, even if dismissed without acting
trigger: Open a private chat profile More > Disable Sharing three times and press Esc each time.
effect: chat_prefs.disable_sharing_box_shown reaches 3 on opens, so the fourth use skips the explanation the user never read and acts at once (or sends them to the Premium preview).
fix: Increment the count when the box's button is pressed, not when it opens.

title: Send Request clears the request box before the send and still jumps to the chat when the send failed
trigger: Open Enable Sharing request box on a private chat, press Send with the connection down.
effect: send_sharing_request: driver.send_sharing_request clears private_sharing.enable before sending; on Err the note shows but the box is gone and select_listed_chat still opens the chat as if the request was sent.
fix: Clear the box only on Ok; keep it open with the error on Err.

title: Privacy overlays are separate Options and bools: editor, exceptions, exception_picker_open, block_picker_open, websites_open, unblock_confirm, sessions_confirm, websites_confirm
trigger: Privacy screen: open a rule editor, its exceptions list, then the add-exception picker; closers in privacy/mod.rs, privacy_radio_row.rs, paid_messages_privacy.rs and settings_window/privacy.rs clear subsets by hand.
effect: No bug found today; the overlay stack is encoded by which fields are set, and each closer must clear the right ones (the picker bools are cleared in about 9 places).
fix: enum PrivacyOverlay { None, Rule(target), Exceptions{target,kind}, ExceptionPicker{..}, BlockPicker, Websites } with confirms as sub-variants.

title: Groups-in-common search field is an Option made on profile open and closed by hand (close/reset), matched to the panel by user_id
trigger: Open profile A, then profile B without close_info_panel in between.
effect: No bug: reset_common_groups_search replaces it on each open and the render filters by user_id; the paging stage (loading_more/exhausted) lives separately in the session.
fix: Make the search part of the panel target value so it is replaced with it.

title: Show My Last Seen toasts success when the privacy request is only queued
trigger: Press Show My Last Seen while TDLib then rejects setUserPrivacySettingRules.
effect: show_mine counts is_ok() of the send as success, shows 'last seen shown' and closes the box.
fix: Toast on the answer, or keep the box in a Saving stage.

title: Quick reply `/` row sends to the main window's open chat, not the chat of the window it was picked in
trigger: Main window has private chat A open; open private chat B in its own chat window; type `/` in B's composer (the menu is built from session.open_chat = A) and pick a shortcut
effect: The shortcut's messages are sent to chat A instead of B (or nothing when the main window has no chat open)
fix: Resolve the target with viewed_chat() (window scope) in send_quick_reply_row, command_menu_state and sync_command_menu, or carry the ChatId in the menu item.

title: Recording chat action (recording voice/video) goes to the main window's open chat, not the recording's chat window
trigger: Start a voice note in a chat window for chat B while the main window shows chat A
effect: Chat A's members see 'recording voice message' while the user records in B; B shows none; cancels when main has no chat open
fix: Pass the recording's origin chat (Capture::origin chat) to sync_voice_recording/sync_video_note_recording instead of reading session.open_chat.

title: 'Play once' offered by the main window's chat kind, not the recording window's chat
trigger: Main window on a private chat, chat window on a group; record a voice note in the group, toggle Play once, send (send_finished_voice applies recording.once without re-checking chat kind)
effect: Group voice note sent as one-time message / refused, or the toggle missing in a private chat window when main has a group open
fix: Compute once_allowed from the capture's origin chat and re-check it at send time.

title: Secret-chat layer check for round video uses the main window's open chat
trigger: Chat window on an old-layer secret chat, main window on a normal chat: record a video note in the chat window
effect: Video note allowed to an old-layer secret chat (or blocked wrongly in the opposite case)
fix: Use viewed_chat() in open_secret_chat_peer_layer.

title: Camera/save answers matched by a per-PhotoSources serial that is resolved through a moving photo_target()
trigger: Start the camera in the edit-profile dialog (serial 1), then an Edit-group box or New Group box with its own PhotoSources at serial 1 becomes the photo_target before the worker answers
effect: The late stream is attached to the other dialog's sources, or the answer is dropped and starting never clears
fix: Key the answer by (target owner, serial), or hold the answer task inside the PhotoSources that asked.

title: Taken photo preview is a newer frame than the saved JPEG
trigger: Click Take photo; while the JPEG saves the stream keeps drawing newer frames into camera.live; on completion camera.live is frozen as the shot
effect: Preview shows a different picture than the file that is cropped and uploaded
fix: Stop the stream (or freeze live) when Take photo is pressed, not when the save answers.

title: Camera stage is spread over starting + stream + live + shot + PhotoSources::busy/mode/serial
trigger: Open camera, take, retake, lock, close
effect: Stages (starting, live, taking, taken, failed) are inferred from combinations; busy is shared with other panels
fix: enum CameraStage { Starting{serial}, Live{stream,frame}, Taking{serial,frame}, Taken{path,image}, Failed(note) } inside SourceMode::Camera.

title: Slider quantisation can feed back into the colour while syncing controls
trigger: Type a hex colour; editor_sync_controls sets the three sliders to to_hsl(color); if a slider set_value emits Change with a stepped value, editor_slider_moved sees hsl differ and rewrites colour and hex
effect: Colour drifts by a rounding step and the hex field is rewritten under the caret
fix: Ignore slider events raised by programmatic set_value (a guard enum on the editor) or derive sliders from colour only.

title: Proxy editor closes on 'request sent', not on TDLib's answer
trigger: Save an add/edit that TDLib rejects after the request was sent
effect: Box closes as if saved; the error only shows as Settings error text on the page behind
fix: Keep the editor in a Saving stage until the add/edit answer, close on ok, show error on err.

title: 'Warning confirmed for this run' resets on account switch
trigger: Confirm the IP-exposure warning, switch account, open another proxy link
effect: The one-time warning appears again; the field lives in the per-account SettingsUi although documented as per run
fix: Keep it in an app-wide struct (allowlisted) or document it as per account.

title: Proxy link box stage is draft + warn bool + a ping slot in Session
trigger: Open a tg://proxy link, press Check status, accept the warning, connect
effect: Stages (shown, warning, checking, result) are spread over ProxyLinkBox::warn, the shared LINK_PING_ID entry and ProxyUi::ip_warning_acked
fix: enum LinkStep { Review, Warn, Checking, Result(PingStatus) } in ProxyLinkBox.

title: Pull-to-next stage kept by PullMachine plus target, next_chat, next_topic, window and jump Task kept in step by hand
trigger: Pull at the bottom, release on a ready pull, switch chat or topic during the 1.5 s jump wait
effect: machine.jumping() can stay set while jump/next_* were cleared by pull_sync (or the reverse); resets happen in pull_sync and ad hoc in pull_jump_when_ready
fix: Fold next_*, window and the jump Task into the machine's Jumping { next, task } variant so leaving it drops them together.

title: Quick-reply edit/add closes the edit state when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Edit a message, Save, server rejects it
effect: Field is cleared and editing ends though the text was not saved; the server error is a generic line
fix: Hold the text in a Saving stage until the shortcut update arrives or fails.

title: Quick replies dialog: view enum plus editing, confirm_delete, local_error and a watch Task cleared by hand per transition
trigger: Open a shortcut, start an edit, press Delete twice, go back
effect: editing/confirm_delete/local_error reset in quick_replies_go but toggled independently elsewhere; watch Option is a 'poll running' flag
fix: Put editing, confirm_delete and error inside View::Shortcut{..} so changing view drops them.

title: Reaction fly-up animation starts before the request and stays when the request fails
trigger: Add a reaction while offline or when toggle_reaction_choice returns Err
effect: The emoji flies up from the message though no reaction was added
fix: Set reaction_fly only on Ok from the driver call.

title: Message menu is menu + menu_ui.page + menu_link + menu_item + menu_selection + reactions_expanded + link_tooltip set by hand in open_message_menu
trigger: Right-click a message, expand reactions, pick one (reaction_cell sets menu = None directly), right-click again
effect: Close paths differ (close_message_menu, reaction_cell, close_context_menus); stale link/item/selection survive until the next open resets them
fix: MessageUi::menu: Option<OpenMenu{state,page,link,item,selection,expanded}> so closing drops all.

title: Recording stage is spread over capture, start, locked, discard_confirm, once, voice_tick and preview
trigger: Hold-to-record, lock it, open the discard row, toggle play once, pause and preview; cancel, send or close the window.
effect: No bug today: end_capture_flags resets locked/discard_confirm/once/round_preview by hand in the take paths, but preview is cleared separately by callers (stop_record_preview) and voice_tick by the tick task.
fix: One enum Recording { Idle, Opening{..}, Recording{capture, mode: Held|Locked, once, confirm_discard}, Paused{.., preview} } so flags die with the capture; voice_tick becomes Option<Task>.

title: RequestShare stage is confirm bool + selected + locate Option + a separate request_locate task
trigger: Press a bot Location or Users request button, pick, go to confirmation, close the box while the lookup runs.
effect: No bug today: the closed box leaves MessageUi::request_locate running (its answer is dropped when request_share is None) and a retry replaces the task by hand.
fix: enum RequestStage { Picking{selected}, Confirm{selected}, Locating(Task), Located(GeoOutcome) } held inside RequestShare so the task is dropped with the box.

title: Schedule picker is schedule_picker Option plus schedule_popup_open bool kept in step by hand
trigger: Open the schedule chip, click the chip again (popup_open=false), send, or open the scheduled list.
effect: schedule_popup_open is cleared in 5 places (chip toggle, send paths, open_scheduled_dialog) without clearing schedule_picker, so a picker with its target, slot, repeat and error stays live while hidden; no visible bug found because every opener replaces it.
fix: Drop schedule_popup_open: the popup is shown exactly when schedule_picker is Some; hiding means setting it to None.

title: Screen chooser stage is window + opening epoch + for_call + sources + selected + generation kept in step by hand
trigger: Press share screen in a call: listing, window open, closed, error, empty list, account switch.
effect: No bug confirmed: screen_chooser_closed resets all of it, but each branch of screen_chooser_listed clears a different subset (see the Err arm).
fix: enum Chooser { Closed, Listing{epoch, generation, for_call}, Open{window, for_call, sources, selected, audio} }.

title: A failed source listing leaves for_call set with no chooser
trigger: In a call press share screen when listing sources fails (e.g. the backend errors).
effect: for_call stays Some(..) while window is None and sources empty (the empty-list arm clears it, the error arm does not); stop_screen_source/accept_screen_source then act on a chooser that is not open until the call ends.
fix: Move the reset into one Chooser::Closed transition used by the error and empty arms.

title: Rich paste notice stage is shown_at Option + field Option
trigger: Paste markdown, wait 9 s, edit the field, click the toast action.
effect: No bug today: field is cleared in three places (timer, action, stale check) and shown_at gates the throttle and the timer by value.
fix: enum PasteNotice { Idle{last: Option<Instant>}, Showing{at, field} }.

title: Rich draft stage is rich_editor_open bool + stored draft + composer text + rich_draft_box
trigger: Open a rich draft in the editor, send plain, close the editor, discard.
effect: rich_editor_open is set and cleared at call sites (open_rich_draft, close_rich_editor, send_rich_draft_plain, open_rich_editor_with_field, send paths) and decides whether the draft shows in place of the field; no failing path found.
fix: enum RichComposer { Field, Preview, Editor, Box(RichDraftBox) } in ChatUi.

title: The tag-name box is not per_window, so a tag menu used in a chat window opens the box in the main window
trigger: Open Saved Messages in a chat window, right-click a tag chip on a message, Add Name.
effect: dialogs.saved_tag_dialog is account-level and the SavedTagName spec has no per_window(), so the box appears over the main window (and Save acts from there) instead of the window that asked.
fix: Own the tag-name box in the asking window's state (ChatUi/message_ui) and mark the spec per_window.

title: Reply in Another Chat drops the reply when the destination chat is not opened
trigger: With an agent driving the window that may not open the destination, pick a chat in Reply in Another Chat.
effect: The reply is cleared from this composer before select_chat_request, which returns false on refusal (agent_may_open) without restoring it; the note still says replying from another chat.
fix: Take the reply only after the open succeeded, or restore it on a false return.

title: Render-driven load-more asks every frame when the request is refused (no more_failed set)
trigger: Search results open with a next page (has_more) scrolled near the end while the client is shutting down or not Ready (chats_path_active false), e.g. during log out/close.
effect: Each frame defers maybe_load_more_search -> load_more_search_ui -> load_more_search_results returns Err(InvalidRequest) without begin_more/fail_page, so loading_more/more_failed never change; every frame sets an error note and cx.notify(): a redraw/request loop and repeated error toasts. In a demo session (no live) load_more_search_ui only notifies, same loop if has_more.
fix: Make paging a Fetch-like enum (Idle/Loading/Failed) on SearchTabsState and have the UI path set Failed on any Err, not just on a send error.

title: Opening a found chat/message proceeds in the UI when the driver refused
trigger: Click a search result while select_search_chat_open/select_search_message fails (flush_leaving_composer or select_chat returns Err, e.g. not Ready).
effect: Error note is shown, but enter_chat_ui, restore_open_draft and clearing the search field still run: the chat UI is entered for a chat that is not open (fixed up later by sync_chat_ui), the search stays open in the session with an emptied field and stale results.
fix: Return early on Err (or make the open an enum result) and only then enter the chat UI and clear the field.

title: Two-step password/email form clears and returns to Status even when the send failed
trigger: Change/enable/disable 2FA, press submit while set_two_step_password or set_recovery_email returns Err (connection not ready/shutdown).
effect: All inputs are emptied, the view goes to Status with no error line; the change was never sent and the typed password/hint/email are lost, so the box looks saved.
fix: Keep the form until the driver accepts; on Err set twofa.notice and stay on the form (a Submit stage enum: Editing/Sending/Failed).

title: Registered/SignedIn result is dropped silently when finish_register/finish_login refuse
trigger: Touch the security key to finish creating a passkey while adding is already true or the client is no longer Running (chats_path_active false).
effect: The ceremony dialog closes as if done (ceremony taken) and the result is discarded with `let _ =`: no error, no passkey, and the user has to guess. Same for start_passkey_creation, which returns silently when begin_register is Err (Create Passkey does nothing).
fix: On Err show CeremonySheet::Error (or a note) instead of taking the ceremony; surface begin_register errors.

title: `added` flag is only consumed by the ticker, which the lock ends: it sticks and closes the next Create box
trigger: Create a passkey, lock Quill while addLoginPasskey is in flight (ticker ends via close_passkey_ceremony_for_lock), the answer lands and sets PasskeysState::added; unlock, open Protect your account, press Create Passkey.
effect: The first tick of the new ticker takes the old added=true and sets about_open=false: the Protect your account box closes at once under the new ceremony.
fix: Turn adding/added/ceremony into one PasskeyAdd enum (Idle, Options, Adding, Added) consumed by whichever frame sees it, or reset added when the ticker starts.

title: Self-destruct tick task is guarded by an Option<ChatId> started flag; A -> B -> A within a second runs two tasks
trigger: Open a secret chat with a live self-destruct timer, switch to another chat with a timer and back within one second.
effect: tick_chat is A again so ensure_self_destruct_tick spawns a second task for A while the first (still sleeping) sees still_open and keeps going: two tasks notify every second until the timers end.
fix: Hold the task itself in the owner (Option<(ChatId, Task)>) so replacing it drops the old one.

title: ScreenShareUi is a hand-synced chooser state machine
trigger: Open the share chooser, cancel, switch call or account.
effect: window, opening, for_call, sources, selected, with_audio, generation, privacy_for, group_call must change together (closed by close_screen_chooser / goodbye by hand); stages (Closed/Listing/Open/PrivacyBox) are implied.
fix: enum ScreenChooser { Closed, Listing{epoch,gen,for_call}, Open{window,for_call,sources,selected,audio}, PrivacyBox{for_call} }.

title: CeremonyUi keeps sheet, worker handle, qr and focus_pin in step by hand
trigger: Any ceremony event (Hybrid, PhoneConnecting, Failed, UseKey).
effect: sheet and ceremony: Option<Ceremony> and qr must change together (Failed sets sheet=Error, ceremony=None, qr=None; set_ceremony_sheet clears qr); focus_pin is a one-shot flag; the dialog open predicate also excludes Probing, so the ceremony can be running with no dialog and no way to cancel.
fix: Make each CeremonySheet variant own what it needs (Choose{qr}, Pin{invalid,focus}, Running{ceremony}) so the worker handle lives only in running sheets.

title: Passkey ticker is an Option<Task> used as a started flag
trigger: Create Passkey / Log in using passkey; lock; finish.
effect: ticker.is_some() means running; cleared by the task itself at its end and by the lock; busy is derived from ceremony + driver adding/ceremony/login state, a second copy of the stage.
fix: One PasskeyFlow enum in the owner with the ticker task inside the busy variants.

title: Two-step box: open bool, view, confirm and notice kept in step
trigger: Open 2FA, move between Enable/Change/Disable/Recover, close.
effect: twofa.open (bool mirror of the dialog), view, confirm, notice and the session's twofa_flow.notice are reset together in goto_twofa_view/close_twofa and again in build_twofa_dialog (state mutated during dialog build).
fix: enum Twofa { Closed, Open{view, confirm, notice} } with transitions only in methods.

title: Devices page: session_details, renaming_device, sessions_confirm and device QR/scan are separate flags/options
trigger: Open a session's details, start Rename, press Terminate, leave the page.
effect: renaming_device is only meaningful with session_details and is cleared by hand in fetch_sessions, leave_devices, close_sessions_top; device_login_qr and device_qr_scanner are exclusive Options; sessions_mutating/sessions_stale/storage_stats_loading sit beside Fetch in Session.
fix: enum DeviceLayer { None, Details{id, renaming}, Confirm(..)} and enum DeviceLink { Idle, Scanning, Consent(qr) }; fold mutating/stale into Fetch variants.

title: Top-people strip expansion lives in two owners (session top_view + SearchUi top_toggled_at/top_drag)
trigger: Toggle Show more / Collapse in the frequent contacts strip; drag the row.
effect: top_view (Session) and top_toggled_at/top_drag/top_scroll (SearchUi) are changed together by hand in toggle_top_people; top_drag is Option<TopDrag{moved}> set on mouse down and cleared in several handlers.
fix: enum TopStrip { Collapsed, Expanding{since}, Expanded, Dragging{..} } in SearchUi only.

title: Delete-selection and single-delete alert boxes are not tied to the account/chat that opened them
trigger: Select messages in account A, click Delete N so the alert opens, then switch account (shortcut, notification click, deep link) and press Delete
effect: The on_ok closure applies the captured chat_id/ids to whatever live driver is on screen; a private chat id shared by two accounts deletes message ids in the wrong account (the kit alert is not a registered DialogKind, so no Farewell closes it)
fix: Register the alert as a DialogKind owned by OnScreen (or carry an AccountKey and compare on ok) so a switch closes it.

title: Report and Save-as-HTML end the selection with clear_forward, which toasts 'Forward cancelled'
trigger: Select a message, click Report N (or Save as HTML)
effect: A 'Forward cancelled' note appears although nothing was forwarded
fix: Split ending a selection (no toast) from cancelling a forward; ForwardStage transition without the note.

title: Save as HTML with 'Ask where to save' clears whatever selection/forward exists after the picker, and a second click opens a second picker
trigger: Select one rich message, click Save as HTML (folder picker opens), change the selection or start a forward, then pick a folder; or click Save as HTML twice
effect: clear_forward drops an unrelated selection/forward draft; two pickers lead to two exports of the same message; the export uses the captured chat/message, not the current selection
fix: Make the picker a stage (ForwardStage::SavingHtml{chat,msg}) and apply the answer only if the stage is still that one.

title: begin_vanish starts the delete effect before delete_selected is known to succeed
trigger: Delete messages when delete_selected returns Err (or the server refuses)
effect: The messages play the vanish animation and hide although they were not deleted
fix: Start the vanish effect when the deletion update arrives, not at the click.

title: selection_drag_loop is a 'started' flag kept beside message_ui.selection_drag
trigger: Press on a history row and drag
effect: Loop-running flag and drag Option must be kept in step by hand; the flag is cleared only at the end of the spawned task
fix: Hold the task in the DragSelect value (Option<Task>) so dropping the drag stops the loop.

title: The 15 ms drag poll never checks that a button is still down
trigger: Press on a row, release the button where no mouse-up reaches the window (another window grabbed it), move the pointer back
effect: selection_drag stays Some, the loop keeps polling and extends the range/autoscrolls with no button held, until the next click
fix: Stop the loop when window.pressed_button is None.

title: PasskeysUi holds list_open, about_open, confirm, ceremony and ticker for one passkey flow
trigger: Open Privacy > Passkeys, Create, delete
effect: Three dialogs and a ceremony are separate bools/options whose priority and cleanup (close_passkeys keeps pin_input and ticker by hand) is kept in step manually
fix: One enum PasskeysScreen { Closed, List, About, DeleteConfirm{id}, Ceremony{..} } with the ticker inside the Ceremony variant.

title: Two-step verification flow is spread over twofa.view, twofa.notice, twofa.confirm, twofa_flow.* and password_state_loading
trigger: Open Privacy > Two-step verification, use Forgot password / login email
effect: View, notice line, inline confirm, session flow notice and code_sent_to fields are cleared together by hand in goto_twofa_view and clear_twofa_flow
fields: TwofaUi::view, notice, confirm; TwofaFlow::notice, recovery_code_sent_to, login_email_code_sent_to; AuthState::password_state_loading
fix: One TwofaStage enum carrying the code-sent pattern and a Fetch<PasswordState>.

title: Recovery and login-email forms clear the typed code, new password and hint right after sending, whatever the outcome
trigger: Forgot password > enter a wrong code and a new password > Save (or enter a bad login email > submit)
effect: The server rejects it but the inputs are already empty, so the user retypes everything; also cleared when the driver call itself returned Err (error ignored with let _)
fix: Clear inputs when the success answer arrives, and show the error when the send fails.

title: Connected websites screen: websites_open + websites_confirm in the UI and connected_websites/loading/stale/error/mutating in settings
trigger: Open Connected websites, Refresh, Disconnect
effect: Fetch stage is Option + loading + stale + error flags; refresh_websites resets cache and stale by hand
fields: PrivacyUi::websites_open, websites_confirm; SettingsState::connected_websites, connected_websites_loading, websites_stale, websites_error, websites_mutating
fix: Fetch<Vec<ParsedWebsite>> plus a Mutating enum; websites_confirm inside one WebsitesScreen enum.

title: Session details box is session_details Option plus renaming_device bool
trigger: Devices > open the session box > Rename
effect: Edit mode is a bool beside the target id; both are reset by hand in four places (row click, close, terminate, leave_devices)
fix: enum SessionBox { Closed, Details(id), Renaming }.

title: sessions_layer_open reads session_details while the dialog is open only when details_session() resolves
trigger: Open a session's box, terminate that session from another device so it leaves the list
effect: The box closes (is_open false) but session_details and renaming_device stay set, so the first Esc on the Devices page is swallowed closing an invisible layer
fix: Drop session_details when its session leaves the list, or derive sessions_layer_open from details_session().

title: Rich-HTML export outcomes are polled only for the account on screen
trigger: Start Save as HTML in account A, switch to B before it ends
effect: The finished outcome stays in A's background driver; no toast until switching back, then a stale 'saved' toast
fix: Poll or drain outcomes per background account.

title: The send-as menu shows a spinner whenever the sender list is empty, loaded or not
trigger: Open the send-as menu when get_chat_available_message_senders fails or returns nothing
effect: Spinner forever; no error or close
fix: Fetch<Vec<AvailableMessageSender>> so failed shows an error row.

title: A background account's failed file preparation or missing client toasts an error on the account on screen
trigger: Account A: attach a large photo and tap Send (files are being prepared). Switch to account B before preparation finishes, with ffmpeg failing or timing out for the photo (or A's client gone).
effect: B's screen shows an error note ('could not send' / the prepare error) that belongs to A's send; A's draft and tray stay. deliver_live_send guards its success/failure notes with on_screen, but finish_media_prep's Err arm (line 302) and deliver_live_send's missing-client arm (line 324) set the note unconditionally.
fix: Route the note through the origin account: set it only when origin.slot.account is the screen's account (the on_screen test already in deliver_live_send), else drop it or queue it for that account.

title: Per-path read stages kept as a checking map plus a checked set, three times, per window
trigger: Attach a photo, a video or a picture-as-file to a tray.
effect: Each of sound_checking/sound_checked, thumbnailing/thumbnailed, media_checking/media_checked is an unseen/checking/done machine kept in step by hand, with job counters (sound_jobs, thumbnail_jobs, media_check_jobs) matching answers. forget() must clear all six by hand.
fix: One HashMap<PathBuf, TrayRead> with enum TrayRead { Reading{job}, Done(Outcome) } per read kind (or one per path holding all three), so a path has exactly one stage per kind.

title: Tray read state lives in the per-window SendBoxUi but trays are account-wide, so another window can start, miss or forget a tray's reads
trigger: A chat window and the main window are open on the same account; the main window's chat has a tray whose photo/video read is still running. Send or attach in the chat window: check_tray_videos/check_tray_media loop over every tray of the account and record jobs in the chat window's send_box. Or send from a chat window whose preparation finishes after it closed: forget_tray_checks clears self.screen.composer_ui.send_box (whatever window is in place), not the window that read the file.
effect: The other window's tray_videos_checking / tray_media_checks_pending / tray_thumbnails_pending see no job for those paths, so its Send can go before the read ends (a soundless video not turned into a GIF, a HEIC not converted). Reads are also duplicated. media_checked/sound_checked entries remain in the window that did not forget them, so the same file attached again later reuses a stale answer (an old temp JPEG path).
fix: Key the read stages by tray (SendSlot) and keep them in ComposerSends next to the attachments they describe, not in the window's ComposerUi.

title: Send menu stage is a set of bools and Options: expanded, search, _search_changed, preview, leaving, card_menu
trigger: Right-click Send, expand the effect list, pick an effect, right-click the card button.
effect: Closed/strip/expanded/card/card-menu is spread over expanded: bool, search+_search_changed (set together in expand_send_effects), preview/leaving Options and card_menu; a preview that finished fading stays Some(hiding) and keeps the strip paused.
fix: enum MenuStage { Strip, Expanded{search,query,_sub}, } with a separate Card enum { None, Shown(Preview), Fading{old,new}, Menu(..) } so each stage owns its data.

title: The send menu stays open (hidden) when the chat changes without a click, and reappears on return
trigger: Right-click Send in chat A, then switch to chat B with a keyboard shortcut or the quick switcher while the pointer still rests over the strip. send_menu_dismissed keeps the menu when the mouse is over a picker part; send_menu_overlay then draws nothing because viewed_chat != open.chat, but composer_ui.send_menu.open stays Some(chat A). Return to chat A.
effect: The old menu (and effect card) pops back up in chat A with a stale state; meanwhile its kit PopupMenu entity and subscriptions are held. Nothing closes the menu on a chat change.
fix: Close the send menu in the chat-change reset (sync_chat_ui / a Farewell of the composer), or make the stage a ChatUi field so it is replaced with the chat.

title: After the effect card fades out the strip's hover animation stays paused until the menu closes
trigger: Right-click Send, pick an effect (card shows), click the card to hide it, hover another strip cell.
effect: preview stays Some with hiding set after it faded (it is never cleared), so paused = open.preview.is_some() is true and hovered cells only show their first frame.
fix: Clear open.preview when it has faded (or compute paused from hiding.is_none()), i.e. make the card stage an enum with a Gone variant.

title: A sticker flight armed in a chat window that closes before it lands is never ended and the sent sticker stays hidden
trigger: Send a sticker from a chat window's panel and close that window within about 2 seconds, then open the same chat in the main window.
effect: FLY (a thread-local, not owned by the window) keeps window=Some(chat). send_fly_overlay returns None in every other window and only the owning window's overlay clears FLY, so wrap() keeps replacing the matching outgoing sticker with an empty placeholder in the main window until another sticker is sent or the app restarts.
fix: Own the flight in the WindowSlot (or end it from the window's Farewell); at least clear FLY when the window it names closes.

title: The 'No' note of the phone-number prompt is never reset
trigger: In Settings > Account answer 'No' to 'Is +X still your number?', later answer Yes (or let TDLib drop the suggestion), then get the suggestion again in the same session.
effect: settings.phone_change_note stays true for the life of the account's OnScreen, so the explanation is already open the next time the prompt appears. Nothing clears it when the suggestion goes away.
fix: Make the prompt a small enum (Asking, NotMine) owned by the suggestion, reset when the suggestion leaves chat_list.suggestions.actions.

title: Keybinding capture and its error, and the system accent with its probed flag, are separate fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Settings > Appearance > Shortcuts: start a capture, hit a conflict, change account.
effect: keybinding_capture: Option<String> and keybinding_error: Option<(String,String)> must be cleared together (done by hand in invalidate_account_keybindings and in 3 UI sites); system_accent: Option<u32> + system_accent_probed: bool is Unprobed/Probed(Option); keybindings_applied is a 'started' bool.
fix: enum Capture { Idle, Waiting(action), Refused{action,message} }; enum SystemAccent { Unread, Read(Option<u32>) }.

title: Settings boxes duplicate their open state in a bool next to the dialog registry
trigger: Settings > Account > Log out; Settings > Stickers manager.
effect: log_out_confirm and sticker_settings_open are bools set beside open_box(DialogKind::..) and cleared by hand in several places (log_out.rs three sites, settings_window/mod.rs:160, stickers_manager/mod.rs); archive and the mask/emoji boxes keep their flag in the Session and need the Farewell to close them.
fix: One open-state per box in the dialog registry (DialogKind is the stage), no mirrored bool in SettingsUi.

title: Archive settings: archive_settings_loading bool beside an Option of the loaded value, and an open flag in the Session
trigger: Settings > Privacy > Archive and Mute, or the archive settings box, with a failing request.
effect: archive_settings_loading: bool + archive_chat_list_settings: Option<_> are Fetch<T> by hand (cleared in apply.rs:217 and error.rs:138, set in connect/chat_list/mod.rs:402 only when the Option is None); archive_settings_open lives in the Session and needs SettingsUi's Farewell to close it.
fix: Fetch<ArchiveChatListSettings> in the chat-list state; the box's open flag in the UI dialog registry.

title: Rename-device mode is a bool plus an input entity cleared at about ten sites
trigger: Settings > Privacy > Active sessions > this device > Rename.
effect: privacy.extra.renaming_device is set here and cleared by hand in security/mod.rs (3 sites), session_list.rs (4 sites) and save_device_name; the typed text lives in rename_input and is re-seeded on each begin.
fix: Session detail view as enum { Details, Renaming(Entity<InputState>) } owned by the session box.

title: Reset-token confirmation is a bool set beside open_box and cleared by hand
trigger: Settings > Agent access > Reset token.
effect: agent_ui.page.reset_confirm duplicates DialogKind::AgentResetToken; confirm_agent_token_reset clears it, other closers must as well; the early return on refuse_if_injecting leaves it set.
fix: Let the dialog registry be the only open state; no mirrored bool.
